summary: Iteration 4 — Online-count feature (heartbeat + admin online endpoint) fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest pass (10 new heartbeat tests + 12 regression). Frontend (mobile 375x667): app loads, `useHeartbeat` POSTs to /api/heartbeat within first tick with correct payload {session_id, role:'customer'}; session_id persists to localStorage under key `lumen:session_id`. Admin login with 'puzopb' still works; Statistika tab renders `online-card` with pulsing green dot, `online-total` big number (=9 during test), and a customer/admin split chip row (6 klijenata / 3 admin). Regression areas (admin login, pending banner path, PDF report card, price editing, blocked days, QR, home price pill, booking full status flow, tab badge live update) unchanged from iteration 3.

issues: Recurring RN Web warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); 'useNativeDriver' unsupported on web for the pulsing dot animation — cosmetic only, animation still runs on JS driver.

action_items: Optional: set `useNativeDriver: false` (or gate via Platform.OS==='web') for the online-dot Animated loop in admin.tsx OnlineNowCard to silence the warning on web.

Optional: sessions collection has no TTL index — stale docs older than 60s stay forever in Mongo. Consider a TTL index on `last_seen` (or scheduled cleanup) to keep the collection bounded, though it does not affect correctness of the /admin/online count (60s cutoff is enforced at query time).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:160 — good: `_id` excluded from projection, so no MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue.

server.py:159 — cutoff uses `datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()` which sorts correctly against stored ISO strings (both include +00:00). Verified via direct-DB test that a doc with last_seen 2min ago is excluded and returns to the count as soon as its last_seen is refreshed.

useHeartbeat.ts — role is stored in a ref that is updated via a separate useEffect on password change, but the interval callback closes over `roleRef.current`, so the next tick correctly sends 'admin'. Fine.
useHeartbeat.ts — no cleanup on unmount for the initial one-off `beat()` fetch, but it's fire-and-forget with silent catch, so acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Heartbeat tests create ephemeral session_id docs (TEST_*). The stale-session test cleans up its own docs. Other TEST_ session docs will naturally expire from the /admin/online count after 60s (they remain in DB — see action item about TTL).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin pw = 'puzopb'. Heartbeat feature: POST /api/heartbeat {session_id, role} upserts a doc; GET /api/admin/online with x-admin-password header returns {online_total, customers, admins} counting docs with last_seen within the last 60s. Frontend hook `useHeartbeat` runs from _layout, stores session_id in AsyncStorage/localStorage under 'lumen:session_id', beats every 30s and on AppState active (native only). Admin UI: Statistika tab has OnlineNowCard (testID `online-card`, `online-total`), refreshes every 15s. If retesting the 60s expiry live, prefer direct-DB manipulation over sleep(65).
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature added cleanly, no bugs found.
